title: Oven Baked Malaysian Chicken Bake
description: A solo dinner Malaysian dish featuring yeasty and springy chicken baked in enchilada sauce, this low-carb-friendly recipe is perfect for a quick dinner, it is cooked in a kadhai vessel.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yeast, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the yeast mixture.
Heat olive oil in a kadhai vessel over medium heat.
Add the chicken to the kadhai and cook until browned on all sides.
Pour enchilada sauce over the chicken and stir to combine.
Transfer the kadhai to the preheated oven and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the kadhai from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
